source: docs/LUNUM_READINESS.md#evidence-and-evaluation-ledger (24 rows, PR #294 through PR #350, docs/MIXED_CONTEXT_QUALITY.md, issue #342)
verificationMethod: Every mergeCommitSha was checked against `gh pr view <n> --json mergeCommit` AND `git cat-file -t <sha>` in this repository. Every evidencePath and datasetSha256 was checked by reading the file / hashing it with sha256sum. No field was transcribed from tracker prose without independent verification.

entries.resultSummary: Added the versioned testLunumv1 evaluation protocol document, its changelog, and the immutable result-directory layout README under reports/evaluations/testLunumv1/.
entries.limitations: Protocol presence did not itself provide live evidence

entries.resultSummary: Preserved nullable usage and finish-reason completion metadata from the model client instead of dropping it; reasoning-only output now fails closed rather than silently passing through.
entries.limitations: Metadata may remain unavailable when endpoint omits it

entries.resultSummary: Added a deterministic retention coverage-contract planner with fail-closed call-budget and expected-item-id planning logic.
entries.limitations: Planning only; no live model proof

entries.resultSummary: Added the manifest-driven retention CLI producing per-stage JSONL raw output and deterministic recomputation of retention pass/fail.
entries.limitations: Initial implementation tests used mock transport

entries.resultSummary: Added a built-CLI mock fixture transport enabling real CLI integration testing without live model calls.
entries.limitations: Test-only transport

entries.resultSummary: Built the canonical audit inventory/plan module (#312, issue #311), the built-CLI audit executor (#318, issue #313), the protocol-facing JSONL record adapter (#319, issue #314), and the complete real-evidence bundle generator (#320, issue #315) -- together a full deterministic audit pipeline with no target-model calls baked into the infrastructure itself.
entries.limitations: Infrastructure correctness is distinct from model quality

entries.resultSummary: Froze #253's dataset hash, equalized the two model profiles, and authored the full 2x4x2 frozen experiment-manifest matrix for comparable live audit inputs.
entries.limitations: Original per-language retention shape was later found unrunnable

entries.resultSummary: Corrected the 8 per-language retention manifests frozen by #321 (all 8 were unrunnable because planRetentionExecution requires expectedItemIds to match the full loaded dataset) by collapsing to 2 manifests, one per model, covering all 16 items; the guarding test now plans against the full dataset exactly as the CLI does.
entries.limitations: Shows why mock/planner tests must match real CLI call shape

entries.resultSummary: Added scripts/verify-audit-endpoints.sh: fail-closed probing of /v1/models, weights path/size/mtime capture, and a minimal probe completion, exiting non-zero on any verification failure.
entries.limitations: Probe success alone did not prove model identity; `/models` and weight facts were required

datasetSha256.verifiedBy: sha256sum against committed file, also cited in BASELINE-REPORT.md

entries.resultSummary: Initial honest live parse and retention baseline recomputed from raw per-item JSONL: parse exact 56.25% (qwen36-35b) / 25% (qwen3-coder-30b), recall 0.9319 / 0.8299, retention 31/32 / 32/32. Both models fail both declared gates (minimumExactRate 0.75, minimumFeatureRecall 0.95). No threshold adjusted.
entries.limitations: Same small 16-item corpus; both models failed declared parse gates at that SHA

evaluatorVerdict.note: boundEvidenceSha matches PR #335's merge commit SHA exactly, confirming the verdict is bound to the corrected (post-#335) evidence state, not PR #336's own merge SHA.

entries.resultSummary: Independent evaluator (orchestrator-synthesized, after 3 infra-failed dispatch rounds against a local sub-evaluator) issued PASS bound to evidence SHA 534edb8f, certifying #253's evidence bundle as complete, internally consistent and honestly reported.
entries.limitations: PASS certified evidence integrity, not that models met quality targets; local evaluator infrastructure had failures disclosed in verdict

entries.resultSummary: Added a 20-item mutation false-positive corpus (5 mutation categories x 4 languages), each item a minimally mutated variant whose gold genuinely differs from its source, plus a coverage test asserting the full 5x4 matrix and real loadDataset compatibility.
entries.limitations: n=4 per mutation category/model; one Indonesian wording caveat retained

entries.resultSummary: Added checkProtectedLiteralPlacement, a structural role-path check that verifies a protected literal reappears at the same semantic role path as gold (not merely anywhere in the serialized output). Offline re-scoring of the committed #253 raw records reproduced the previously reported 0/8 failures for all 16 checks (8 items x 2 models).
entries.limitations: Predicate identity was intentionally excluded from placement path and remains an owner-level interpretation choice

sha256sum against committed file, matches value cited in the report

entries.resultSummary: Executed the mutation false-positive corpus against both #253 models: qwen36-35b 2/20 false positives (10.0%), qwen3-coder-30b 0/20 (0.0%), with the report noting the 0% rate is not comparable quality since coder-30b matches neither gold on 16/20 items.
entries.limitations: Original modality mechanism interpretation was corrected by PR #335

entries.resultSummary: Corrected the false-positive report's stated mechanism: the two surfaced false positives occur because modality was OMITTED by the model (parse collapsed to source meaning), not because the scorer ignored an emitted `modality: permissive` value -- the scorer in fact drives an emitted-but-wrong modality field to score 0.000. Verified in the report's own CORRECTION section, which shows the raw per-item table (emitted permissive/possible -> score 0.000; emitted nothing -> score 0.900/0.810 -> false positive).
entries.limitations: Supersedes the incorrect mechanistic statement in earlier report text, not its raw measurements

entries.resultSummary: Fixed parsePrompt's worked examples (exampleProjectState, exampleConditional, exampleSafety) that used predicates/roles contradicting the controlled vocabulary and gold patterns, and added the missing canonical terms 'below'/'confirmed' to PREDICATES. New regression test verified to fail pre-fix (via git stash) and pass post-fix.
entries.limitations: Prompt change required independent remeasurement

entries.resultSummary: Post-#337 parse remeasurement on the identical #253 corpus: exact 93.75% (qwen36-35b) / 100% (qwen3-coder-30b), recall 1.0 / 1.0. Both models now pass both declared gates on this measurement.
entries.limitations: Same 16-item corpus, single run, not held-out generalization evidence

entries.resultSummary: Added MODALITY_VALUES/MODALITY_VALUE_SET controlled vocabulary to vocabularyBlock() and demonstrated `modality: 'permission'` on a dedicated worked example (moved off exampleConditional to avoid corrupting the already-correct battery-item pattern), extending the #337 regression test.
entries.limitations: Exposed schema inconsistency tracked in #342

entries.resultSummary: Post-#337/#341 remeasurement: modality false positives eliminated (2->0 qwen36-35b, 0->0 qwen3-coder-30b); exact 93.75% / 81.25%; retention 30/32 / 32/32. Also exposed a pre-existing near-semantic scorer blind spot to role swaps (filed separately, fixed by #349).
entries.limitations: Single-run nondeterminism demonstrated; small same corpus

entries.resultSummary: Fixed examplePermission's 'confirmed' condition role from 'subject' to 'agent' to match delete-* gold, and extended the regression test with a general sweep cross-checking every worked example's condition role keys against gold role keys for shared predicates.
entries.limitations: Effect awaits future measurement if needed

entries.resultSummary: Bound near-semantic role-filler features to their clause predicate (e.g. `role-id:<predicate>:<role>:<id>`) so an identical role/id pair filling two different clauses is no longer collapsed into one feature; restored scorer visibility of role-swap mutations. Test fixture fp-role-both-en, copied from the real #328 corpus item that exposed the bug, updated to reflect the fix.
entries.limitations: Threshold unchanged; broader calibration remains an owner decision

entries.resultSummary: Re-scored the committed #253/#344 raw model outputs with the #346 scorer (zero model calls): all 3 role-swap false positives eliminated (1.000->0.771, 0.816->0.643), #253 gate metrics (exact 9/16, 4/16) provably unchanged, zero classification flips on post-#337 parse data.
entries.limitations: Re-scoring cannot prove behaviour on unseen data

entries.resultSummary: Natural/Lunum/mixed context quality framework: MixedContextQualityGate compares accuracy/semantic-similarity/token-efficiency across context modes and task types, producing structured pass/warn/fail gate reports.
entries.limitations: Current quality scoring is heuristic and token counting is approximate; not production compaction proof
entries.discrepancy: None found: docs/MIXED_CONTEXT_QUALITY.md's own 'Limitations' section states 'Quality estimation is heuristic-based ... Token counting uses character-based estimation (~4 chars per token)', which matches the tracker's summary closely; no correction needed.

entries.resultSummary: Open issue: ModalityType (10 values, includes 'permission') disagrees with the v02Clause modality enum (4 values, excludes 'permission' and others); v01Clause.modality is an unconstrained free string. The mutation-false-positive-v1 gold uses modality:'permission', which is valid under v01 but not under the v02 enum.
entries.limitations: Open owner/architecture decision; no dataset/evidence mutation should precede it
